content.short: Adaly is a Cardano wallet for managing ADA balances, transfers, staking, and hardware-wallet access from a lightweight web interface.
content.description: Adaly is a Cardano wallet built for users who want a simple interface for checking balances, sending and receiving ADA, staking, and reviewing transactions. The project also exposes a remote blockchain explorer and supports hardware-wallet access, including Ledger connectivity, so users can manage Cardano accounts while keeping keys on dedicated devices. Its positioning is straightforward: secure everyday wallet functions with lightweight access to Cardano account activity.
content.meta: Find out about Adaly Cardano Wallet (WALLET) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
